question: ________ of the Indian Constitution deals with the protection of interests of minorities.
solution:
The correct answer is **Article 29**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 29** of the Indian Constitution provides for the protection of interests of minorities.
 
• This article ensures that any section of citizens having a distinct language, script, or culture have the right to conserve the same.
 
• It also ensures that no citizen shall be denied admission into any educational institution maintained by the State or receiving aid out of State funds on grounds of religion, race, caste, language, or any of them.
 
• Article 29 is a key provision for safeguarding the cultural and educational rights of minorities in India.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Option 1
 **Article 27** deals with the freedom as to payment of taxes for promotion of any particular religion.
 
 

 Option 2
 **Article 29** deals with the protection of interests of minorities.
 
 

 Option 3
 **Article 28** deals with the freedom as to attendance at religious instruction or religious worship in certain educational institutions.
 
 

 Option 4
 **Article 26** deals with the freedom to manage religious affairs.
